en: A sepia-toned vintage photograph featuring five adults (three women and two men) and a dog standing in front of what appears to be a building entrance, possibly a public establishment. The adults are dressed in late 19th-century or early 20th-century Central European attire. There is handwritten text in a Slavic language (likely Czech) at the bottom of the postcard. Some signage in the window behind the group is visible, including the German word 'Ausgabe' (meaning 'issue' or 'distribution').
